title: AI Runtime Evidence Protocol (AIREP) v0.2.0-beta.1
description: Experimental AIREP beta implementing separate Decision, Control, Execution and Effect artifact families, deterministic wire and integrity construction, bounded assurance semantics, lifecycle reconciliation, a first-party four-family producer, and Python/Node verification paths. This release does not establish event truth, same-version third-party interoperability, production readiness, adoption or standards endorsement.
